Agents at work. You already use coding agents in infrastructure work and have a clear view of where they're reliable and where a human has to review.

Experience building a BYOC, single-tenant, or self-hosted offering at an infrastructure, data, or security company.
Experience with cell-based architecture.
Workload identity and PKI in production: SPIFFE/SPIRE, cert-manager, private CAs.
Your First 90 Days
Take a customer-hosted deployment from pre-production to production with the customer.
Make the next install need no bespoke work, starting from the templates, bootstrap, and pre-install checks.
Ship a release through one delivery pipeline to hosted and customer-hosted deployments, with staged rollout and rollback.
Write down availability and durability targets for the hosted service, with the alerts and runbooks behind them.
Who Will Love This Job
You want to build a product that runs in someone else's cloud and make it as solid as one you host.
You'd rather fix the product than repeat a custom install.
